title: Grateful Dead Live at Hollywood Palladium on 1971-08-05
lineage: MAR (Harvey Kaslow)* @ 7 1/2 ips. > R @ 7 1/2 ips. (Will Boswell via Rob Bertrando) Maxell UD tape > R > Akai GX625 > apogee mini me (24/96) > apogee  mini dac (monitoring) > Lynx One soundcard > wavelab 5.0 (dithered to 20/44) > CD ** > EAC > WAV (shntool confirms no sbes) > FLAC (TLH)
source: (FOB) Sony ECM-22P condenser mikes into a Sony 770 portable 7 '' reel deck @ 7 1/2 ips.

ai_review.summary: Warm, deep soundboard transfer of the Aug 5 1971 show with missing Not Fade & Bird Song, but a solid performance full of hot licks.
ai_review.review: The recording is praised for its warm, deep sound and generally superior quality to other 1971 sources, though it suffers from missing two songs (Not Fade Away and Bird Song) and may need pitch correction. The show itself is considered “awesome” by reviewers who note plenty of hot licks despite a general wariness of the ’71 era.

ai_rating.rationale: Reviewers are mostly positive about both performance and audio quality, but the missing tracks and need for pitch correction pull the overall rating down.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Warm and deep sound; superior to many other 1971 transfers. Missing Not Fade Away and Bird Song, may require pitch correction; some reviewers note missing material but overall clear.
